# Arch User Repository (AUR) Publishing Guide

This directory contains the packaging files required to publish `airplane-game` and `airplane-game-git` to the [Arch User Repository (AUR)](https://aur.archlinux.org).

---

## 1. Prerequisites

1. Create an account on the [Arch User Repository](https://aur.archlinux.org/register/).
2. Add your SSH public key (`~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` or `~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub`) to your AUR profile settings: `https://aur.archlinux.org/account/`.
3. Configure your local SSH config (`~/.ssh/config`):
   ```ssh-config
   Host aur.archlinux.org
       IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
       User aur
   ```

---

## 2. Choosing a Package Type

| Package | Purpose | Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`airplane-game`** | Stable release package | Tagged release tarballs (`v0.1.1`) on GitHub |
| **`airplane-game-git`** | Development / Rolling package | Latest commit on the `main` branch |

Files in this directory:
- `PKGBUILD`: Packaging script for stable releases.
- `PKGBUILD.git`: Packaging script for `airplane-game-git`.
- `.SRCINFO`: Machine-readable metadata generated by `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.

---

## 3. First-Time Submission (Stable `airplane-game`)

1. Clone the empty AUR repository for your package:
   ```bash
   git clone ssh://aur@aur.archlinux.org/airplane-game.git /tmp/aur-airplane-game
   cd /tmp/aur-airplane-game
   ```

2. Copy the packaging files from this repository:
   ```bash
   cp "/path/to/AirplaneGame/dist/arch/PKGBUILD" ./PKGBUILD
   ```

3. Update the checksum in `PKGBUILD`:
   When publishing a real release tag (e.g. `v0.1.1`), calculate the sha256 of the release tarball:
   ```bash
   updpkgsums
   ```
   *(Alternatively, run `sha256sum airplane-game-0.1.1.tar.gz` and replace `'SKIP'` with the resulting hash)*.

4. Regenerate `.SRCINFO`:
   ```bash
   makepkg --printsrcinfo > .SRCINFO
   ```
   > **Note:** `.SRCINFO` is mandatory on the AUR. The AUR web interface and AUR helpers read `.SRCINFO` directly, not `PKGBUILD`.

5. Test the build in a clean environment:
   ```bash
   # Test building locally
   makepkg -sfc

   # Or test in a clean chroot (recommended by Arch developers)
   extra-x86_64-build
   ```

6. Commit and push to the AUR:
   ```bash
   git add PKGBUILD .SRCINFO
   git commit -m "Release v0.1.1"
   git push origin master
   ```

---

## 4. First-Time Submission (VCS `airplane-game-git`)

1. Clone the empty AUR repository for the git package:
   ```bash
   git clone ssh://aur@aur.archlinux.org/airplane-game-git.git /tmp/aur-airplane-game-git
   cd /tmp/aur-airplane-game-git
   ```

2. Copy `PKGBUILD.git` and rename it to `PKGBUILD`:
   ```bash
   cp "/path/to/AirplaneGame/dist/arch/PKGBUILD.git" ./PKGBUILD
   ```

3. Generate `.SRCINFO`:
   ```bash
   makepkg --printsrcinfo > .SRCINFO
   ```

4. Test build:
   ```bash
   makepkg -sfc
   ```

5. Commit and push:
   ```bash
   git add PKGBUILD .SRCINFO
   git commit -m "Initial commit of airplane-game-git"
   git push origin master
   ```

---

## 5. Releasing New Versions

Whenever a new version of AirplaneGame is tagged:

1. Update `pkgver` and reset `pkgrel=1` in `PKGBUILD`.
2. Run `updpkgsums` to refresh the sha256 checksum.
3. Run `makepkg --printsrcinfo > .SRCINFO`.
4. Commit and push to the AUR repository.
